; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; ; ; :Categories: ; ; CRISP pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; ; :Params: ; ; g : ; ; ; ; flat : ; ; ; ; imm : ; ; ; ; :History: ; ; 2013-06-04 : Split from monolithic version of crispred.pro. ; ; 2018-11-13 : MGL. Don't change the input. ; ; ;- function red_demat, g, flat, imm lim = 0.001 idx = where((g[*,*,0] gt lim) and $ (g[*,*,1] gt lim) and $ (g[*,*,2] gt lim) and $ (g[*,*,3] gt lim), count) if count ge 1 then me = mean(flat[idx]) else me = mean(flat) gf0 = red_fillnan(me/red_fillpix(red_mask_ccd_tabs(g[*,*,0] * flat))) gf1 = red_fillnan(me/red_fillpix(red_mask_ccd_tabs(g[*,*,1] * flat))) gf2 = red_fillnan(me/red_fillpix(red_mask_ccd_tabs(g[*,*,2] * flat))) gf3 = red_fillnan(me/red_fillpix(red_mask_ccd_tabs(g[*,*,3] * flat))) imm_out = imm for ii = 0, 3 do begin ;; Transmitted imm_out[ii*4+0,*,*] *= gf0 imm_out[ii*4+1,*,*] *= gf1 imm_out[ii*4+2,*,*] *= gf2 imm_out[ii*4+3,*,*] *= gf3 endfor return, imm_out end
